description: This file defines the PlacementStrategyResolver class responsible for resolving placement strategies for grain types within the Orleans runtime. It manages strategy retrieval, including default and custom strategies, using dependency injection and caching mechanisms.

classes.name: PlacementStrategyResolver
classes.description: Class responsible for resolving and managing placement strategies for grain types in Orleans.

methods.name: PlacementStrategyResolver
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the resolver with required services, resolvers, and grain properties resolver.

methods.name: GetPlacementStrategy
methods.description: Retrieves the placement strategy for a given grain type, using cache if available.

methods.name: TryGetNonDefaultPlacementStrategy
methods.description: Attempts to resolve a non-default placement strategy for a grain type, considering custom resolvers and properties.

methods.name: GetPlacementStrategyInternal
methods.description: Internal method to get the placement strategy, falling back to default if no custom strategy is found.
